summary: Specifies procedures for processing IPv6 Hop-by-Hop options in routers and hosts. It modifies the rules in RFC 8200 to make the Hop-by-Hop Options header practical to use, so that such options can be deployed. It updates RFC 8200.

eli5.summary: Some notes on a parcel are meant for every post office along the way. This changes the rules so post offices can read those notes without slowing everything down.

questions: how are ipv6 hop-by-hop options processed
why are ipv6 hop-by-hop options dropped
